messages:
Anya Patel: Quick heads-up — Hydra private/VPC deploy window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Final async check: who is deploy lead, who'll run smoke, rollback ready? 02:00-03:00 UTC slot.
Marco Ruiz: I can take deploy lead. I'll be at my desk. Plan: canary 10% for 15m, then promote to 100% if green.
Lia Chen: I'll own smoke tests and post results here. Smoke steps: auth flow, streaming, embeddings, kv cache warm.
Theo Park: I'll watch metrics/traces. Will tail the APM dashboard and jaeger spans.
Priya Ops: Networking team confirmed VPC peering + routes applied. KMS keys rotated yesterday — ARN is in the runbook. No special firewall changes.
devex-bot: Reminder: deploy runbook updated -> https://confluence.redwood/hydra/deploy-runbook (check preflight section).
Marco Ruiz: Rollback plan (short): revert router to previous model variant, scale down new pods, restore previous image tag, un-flight experimental flags. Commands I'll run if needed:
```
./deployctl rollback --env=hydra-prod --tag=2026-03-15-ff12
kubectl -n hydra set image deployment/hydra-server hydra-server=redwood/hydra:2026-03-15-ff12
```
Lia Chen: Smoke checklist (detailed):
- Auth: POST /api/v1/session -> 200 and token
- Generation stream: partial stream within 2s
- KV cache warm: hit rate > 60% after warmup
- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 500ms
- Logs: no ERROR spikes in last 15m (tail logs):
```
kubectl -n hydra logs -l app=hydra-server --since=15m | grep -i error || echo "no errors"
```
Marco Ruiz: Timezone note: 02:00 UTC = 18:00 PST (day before). I'll start preflight at 01:45 UTC: secrets/env check, canary config applied, k8s node drain schedule validated. Anyone blocked by timing?
Anya Patel: Acme (customer POC) will be on the conference line at +1-555-0100 for verification post-smoke. We should confirm they can join at 02:10 UTC.
SRE OnCall (Sam): I'll be reachable on pager. If error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m or avg latency > 500ms for 2m, we trigger rollback.
Theo Park: I'll watch GPU metrics and host OOMs. Alerts to watch: gpu_temp > 85, host_cpu > 90, gpu_memory_pressure.
Priya Ops: I'll hold the network console during cutover and monitor peering health.
Marco Ruiz: :thumbsup: starting preflight 01:45 UTC. Lia — please paste smoke outputs here. If green, promote at ~02:20 UTC.
devex-bot: Deploy window added to calendar: https://calendar.redwood/hydra-deploy-window-1739992345
Lia Chen: Smoke results (01:58 UTC preflight): auth OK, streaming OK, kv warm hit rate 72%, p95=180ms, errors=0/500 requests. Logs: no new ERRORs. Posting sample response times below.
Marco Ruiz: Promoting to 100% now.
SRE OnCall (Sam): Observability green. No error spike, traces clean. Marking deployment as successful from my side.
Anya Patel: Thanks team — great coordination. Please update the runbook with any deviations and file a short post-deploy note in the ticket.
Marco Ruiz: Will file a post-deploy note in the ticket and add the exact image tag + canary timestamps.
Lia Chen: Adding smoke log snippets to the ticket.
Priya Ops: Network checks ok. Closing my watch in 30m unless something pops.
Anya Patel: Closing thread — flag if any late regressions. :rocket:
